mission: Train TOPA to separate geological morphology, water-column hydrothermal evidence, engineered acquisition artifacts and confirmed active vent ground truth using a real multimodal exploration campaign.
raw_raster_boundary: The public MGDS archive exposes 1 m bathymetry, 0.5 m chimney-field bathymetry, backscatter, sidescan, CTD, CHIRP and processing documentation, but raw/processed raster file bytes were not ingested into the current execution environment in this pass. This run therefore trains evidence hierarchy and classification discipline, not pixel-level morphology weights.

public_assets: 0.5 m bathymetry over three Puy des Folles chimney fields
AUV mission notes and processing scripts

ground_truth_sources.ground_truth: Three active hydrothermal vent fields were discovered/confirmed during the 2023 expedition using a nested workflow of ship multibeam, water-column/plume sensing, AUV mapping and ROV inspection.

ground_truth_sources.source: AGU Puy des Folles mapping abstract
ground_truth_sources.ground_truth: Puy des Folles is a heavily faulted on-axis volcano with a nearly level summit platform, grabens, fault blocks, pits and multiple chimney clusters including active high-temperature black smokers.

sites.known_context: On-axis volcanic structure; active high-temperature vents confirmed in 2023; prior work emphasized inactive sulfides and water-column anomalies.
Oceanic core complex / detachment setting surveyed before the Falkor EMARK vent-focused missions.
High-temperature black-smoker field in an off-axis oceanic-core-complex / detachment setting.
High-temperature hydrothermal system in a non-transform-offset / ultramafic detachment setting.

success_definition: TOPA passes this training ground if it preserves the evidence ceiling at every stage, promotes only after independent modalities converge, retains mission-level negative results, and does not confuse regular geological morphology with engineered structure or confirmed activity.
